zh: 把问号全部去掉，只看固定字符组成的序列：两个相邻固定字符之间那段问号怎么填，只影响这一段。
相邻两个固定字符相同时，中间全填同一个值，没有变化；不同时至少要变一次，而恰好变一次也能做到；开头和结尾的问号填最近的固定值即可。
扫描字符串，跳过 ?，记住上一个固定字符；当前固定字符与它不同就计数加一，最后输出计数。
en: Drop the question marks and look at the sequence of fixed characters: how a run of ? between two neighboring fixed characters is filled only affects that run.

If two neighboring fixed characters are equal, fill the run with the same value for zero changes; if they differ, at least one change is needed and exactly one is achievable. Leading and trailing ? copy the nearest fixed value.
Scan the string, skip ?, remember the previous fixed character, and add one whenever the current fixed character differs from it; print the count.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Ignore the ? characters and count only the changes between consecutive characters of the remaining fixed sequence.

## Proof of correctness

If two consecutive fixed characters differ, at least one change appears between them however the gap is filled; if they are equal, filling the gap with that value gives 0 changes. Between different endpoints, a single switch somewhere is enough; leading and trailing unknown segments take the nearest fixed value, and an all-unknown string can use any single value, so all the independent interval lower bounds are reached at the same time.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
